name: Pluto Personal — Strategist + Vault Scratch
description: Pluto's actual personal workflow as a cross-machine template: Claude Code at the user-home level acting as 'Strategist Claude' over an Obsidian-based second-brain vault, paired with a vault-root scratch shell for grep/git/file ops. Demonstrates the dual-Claude pattern (Strategist in this app + Claudian inside Obsidian). The home pane uses ${USERPROFILE} which auto-resolves to the current user's home on Windows (or set HOME on Mac/Linux). The vault pane uses ${VAULT} — set this env var on the welcome screen / shell to your second-brain path, OR edit the cwd to a literal path. If you don't have a second-brain vault, the vault pane will fall back to your home dir; load `claude-code-basic.deck.json` instead if you'd rather skip the vault setup.

tabs.label: Strategist Claude
tabs.system_prompt_hint: Strategist Claude per the user's own second-brain CLAUDE.md (if it exists). Read meta files first before responding to anything substantive. Be blunt and direct. Surface patterns by name.

tabs.label: Vault scratch
startCommands: echo 'VAULT: cwd is ${VAULT}. Set this env var to your second-brain vault path, or edit pack to a literal path.'

env_hints.purpose: Required for the strategist pane. If saved on welcome screen, auto-injected.

notes: ${USERPROFILE} expands to your home dir on Windows (e.g. C:\Users\you). On Mac/Linux, set HOME (usually already set) and replace ${USERPROFILE} with ${HOME} in this pack.

${VAULT} is a custom env var — set it before launching Pluto's Terminals: [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('VAULT', 'C:\path\to\your\vault', 'User'). Restart the app and the vault pane will land in the right dir.
If ${VAULT} isn't set, the vault pane falls back to your home dir.
Pluto's full second-brain reference layout (pluto-mind) is documented separately. If you don't have one yet, watch Pluto's video on building one or use claude-code-basic.deck.json instead.
